premise.claim: Issue #563: "no second recreation; Restarting stays True and the instance stays NotReady until the RoleInstance is deleted" when a member of the rebuilt group fails again before the instance is Ready.
premise.evidence: PR's own envtest spec 'Restart wave completion (#563)' grafted onto base ea5e82ae FAILS: 'the completed wave must persist Restarting=False / Expected True to equal False' (guard never releases). See results/envtest-563-base.txt. Same spec passes on head 145cbadd (results/envtest-563-head.txt).

findings.note: The PR's fix contract: after the first recreation completes (pre-restart Pods gone), a pre-Ready failure of the rebuilt group must trigger a second recreation (RestartCount reaches 2). Red on base, green on head.

The guard's original cascading-deletion purpose and the controller-restart fallback both behave as documented: MemberTerminating triggers are absorbed while pre-restart Pods exist; the persisted fallback blocks before / releases after old-Pod removal.

Residual limitation (minor, pre-existing shape): a pre-restart Pod stuck Terminating (finalizer / dead node) holds the wave guard armed, so a failed replacement cannot start a second recreation — the #563 symptom persists when pre-restart deletion never completes. Documents current behavior; flips red if a release-deadline is ever added.

Acknowledged limitation (minor): the controller-restart fallback counts a Pod created in the same second as LastRestartTime as a replacement (hasPreRestartPods uses strict Before), releasing the guard early for a same-second pre-restart Pod.
